The launcher script and desktop entry are benign. The first model correctly identified the package as safe. The second model's inconclusive verdict was caused by a transient LLM error (empty response) when reviewing the PKGBUILD during the full file review phase, despite passing the initial metadata gate.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is due to a transient LLM error in the second model (deepseek-v4-flash), which returned an empty response when evaluating the PKGBUILD during the full repository review, leading to an 'inconclusive' verdict. The first model correctly evaluated all files and found no issues.
coverage_issues: Second model failed to evaluate PKGBUILD during full review due to an LLM empty response error.
learnings: Handle transient LLM empty responses gracefully by implementing a retry mechanism instead of immediately failing the file audit and marking the package inconclusive.
Avoid re-auditing the PKGBUILD in the full file review phase if it has already passed the initial metadata gate, to save tokens and reduce the chance of transient errors.
